Practised that soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil.

end.parentNote: Pihu practised explaining how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil, and how soil animals help make rich soil from dead leaves. They explained the water-flow idea using the example of a tunnel-shaped pot. The mix-up that earthworms harm soil or eat plants was still present at the end. At home, look at a picture of an earthworm and repeat: “Its tunnels help air and water enter soil, and soil animals help break down dead leaves.”
